source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current properties dialog uses null to choose the default 30 minutes, zero to select Manual, standard values for generated items, and an extra item for a custom configured value. Do not use a falsy default that turns zero into 30. This is a syntax/behavior contract for this preference, not a rule that every unset number uses null.
title: Keep refresh interval zero distinct from an unset interval
